mapper.select: SELECT KT_ORG_ID AS ktOrganizationId, ORGN_ID AS organizationId, ORGN_NM AS organizationName, TYPE_CD AS typeCode, ORGN_LVL_CD AS levelCode, HGHR_ORGN_CD AS higherOrganizationCode, RESPN_PRSN_ID AS respnPrsnId, RESPN_PRSN_NM AS respnPrsnNm, ADM_USER_ID AS admUserId, TELNUM AS telephone, REP_TEL_NO AS representativeTelephone FROM ORG_ORGN_INFO_MST WHERE ORGN_STAT_CD = '4' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN APPL_STRT_DT AND APPL_CMPLT_DT AND USE_YN = 'Y' --ORDER BY NVL(RVISN_DTTM, REG_DTTM) DESC, REG_DTTM DESC
